reported_context.session_intent: Stay within the prescribed low-consequence Stumpjumper dose of two controlled 2K descents.
reported_context.athlete_response: The session was rather easy and the athlete deliberately did not exceed the prescription.

airway_and_illness.context_note: The haze had cleared before the ride.

reported_context.manual_lap_context: Laps 2 and 4 are the 2K trail, with the lap button pressed manually at the same boundaries. Lap 2 included a brief stop for riders doing trail seasoning to pass.
reported_context.speed_provenance: A front-wheel speed sensor was installed for this activity because GPS speed and distance can be unreliable under dense tree cover. Garmin standard device metadata confirms a BIKE_SPEED sensor for the activity.

session_contract_review.workout_feel_athlete_semantics: Garmin Feel 4/5 (strong): athlete composite of clarity, strength and coordination, with no illness reported.
session_contract_review.fueling_and_hydration: 800 ml 100Plus Active and one 15 g honey sachet. The original report said 800L; this record normalizes the clearly implausible unit to 800 ml and remains athlete-correctable.

objective_session_evidence.source: Garmin activity 24179129115, standard activity/split/device/self-evaluation surfaces and preserved detail trace

lap_2_2k.interpretation: The athlete-reported obstruction is visible as approximately 36 seconds of non-moving time; elapsed time is not a clean trail-speed benchmark.

lap_4_2k.interpretation: The second 2K lap is the clean timing reference for this controlled session.

performance_condition.interpretation_guardrail: Performance Condition is a power/heart-rate relative-to-baseline physiological context signal. On variable-terrain MTB it is not a direct measure of technical execution and should be compared within matched Stumpjumper routes, sensor configuration, temperature and effort.

review_policy.guardrail: Do not infer not_triggered. No further athlete questionnaire is required for this familiar, low-consequence session; the missing outcome only prevents nominal stop-rule contract validation.
review_policy.athlete_preference: Use Garmin Feel and Perceived Effort as the default subjective review, and use Stumpjumper Performance Condition as additional physiological context when present.
